title: Christmas Cards
seo_title: Christmas Card Making in Lebanon, MO on Nov 21
description: This is a card-making session where you create 8 Christmas cards from the Kringle & Co. Collection. The cost is $29, and you bring adhesives and trimmers while everything else is provided. It takes place Saturday, November 21, 2026 at 9:00 AM at 301 W. Commercial in Lebanon, MO; a Nov 18 session is also mentioned.
